fns.desc: wpas_dbus_handler_set_pkcs11_engine_and_module_path: pkcs11_engine_path is set to `value`, a raw pointer obtained from dbus_message_iter_get_basic() aliasing the incoming DBusMessage's own internal string buffer (never allocated). On the module_path-missing error path, `os_free(pkcs11_engine_path)` frees this non-heap pointer -- undefined behavior / potential heap corruption or crash, triggerable by any D-Bus caller sending a valid engine_path string followed by a missing/wrong-type module_path arg.
